metrics.method: Full history Mar 23 - Sep 1 2026 (811 lines, 794 messages). Client = sender 'Vale' (client_aliases in config/clients.yaml); every other sender is our side per config/team.yaml. client_questions_total = distinct Vale messages that pose a direct question to the team (question mark, or unambiguous interrogative such as 'So how does that work'), collapsing multi-line restatements of one question into one. unanswered_over_24h = those with no substantive team reply within 24h, including 4 never answered at all (Jun 29 'what customs am I behind on', Jul 28 'Should I change my password?', Aug 3 'Anything I should know before the live?', Aug 7 'what you have on him on your notes'). max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive ALTR-side messages: Aug 20 06:48 (Ollie) to Aug 25 17:46 (Michelle) = 5d11h; runner-up Apr 25 to Apr 30 = 5d2h. promises = explicit forward commitments by our side ('I'll send X', 'we can get them scheduled', a stated cadence); kept = delivered and visible to the client in chat; lapsed = never delivered or never reported back as of 2026-09-04.
